item.title: Utah teen recovers as pediatric telestroke care expands
item.description: Many people might think strokes are just a problem in adults, but kids can have strokes too. A Utah teen's story highlights how time is of the essence.

item.title: Sen. John Curtis says DHS secretary ‘lost’ trust following Minneapolis shooting
item.description: Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem's response to a fatal shooting by agents in Minneapolis will "forever undermine trust" with Americans, Utah. Sen. Johns Curtis said Thursday.

item.title: Experts urge families to wear helmets while sledding
item.description: Helmets have become standard on Utah’s ski slopes, but health professionals say children should also be wearing them during other winter activities, including sledding.

item.title: Utah landlord-tenant bill deemed ‘not ready for prime time’
item.description: A bill in the Utah Legislature that would give landlords more power to terminate rental agreements in certain situations failed to move forward this week.

item.title: Eric Dane, ‘Grey’s Anatomy’ and ‘Euphoria’ star, has died at 53
item.description: Eric Dane, the celebrated actor best known for his roles on “Grey’s Anatomy” and “Euphoria” and who later in life became advocate for ALS awareness, died Thursday. He was 53.

item.title: Alpine skier sees two Olympics in Cortina, 70 years apart
item.description: Bruno Alberti says he's grateful the world is getting another chance to see how beautiful the mountains and the valley are as his hometown of Cortina hosts the Winter Games a second time.

item.title: Keeping sleds together: the mechanic behind the Jamaican bobsled team
item.description: Kiernan has long been a mechanic — but not of sleds. Of cars, racecars. In fact, he’s very familiar with Utah, having tuned up machines at a track.

item.title: Skiers describe trying to help avalanche victim near Brighton
item.description: Siblings Maggie and Harrison Garner were skiing with their friend Darius Christensen in the backcountry in the same area where an avalanche killed a young girl.

item.title: Alysa Liu Olympic Gold inspires Utah’s next generation of figure skaters
item.description: Alysa Liu's Olympic Gold win inspires Utah’s next generation of figure skaters.

item.title: Utah’s rising rugby star eyeing L.A. for 2028 Olympic Games
item.description: As the Winter Games wrap up, many athletes are already preparing for the next Olympic spotlight in Los Angeles 2028. One such athlete is a rising rugby star from Utah... now training alongside a Utah Olympian.
